title: Apple Pie - AEG BE3002420M
summary: Classic double-crust apple pie adapted to the confirmed AEG Competence BE3002420M manual: Conventional Cooking, shelf position 1, 180 C, 70-90 min. The Kenwood KWL90.244SI handles the shortcrust dough, and the Adam apple slicer speeds up coring before final thin slicing.
assumptions: One 20-22 cm pie dish or similar oven-safe dish is used.
Firm tart-sweet apples are used; reduce filling sugar if the apples are very sweet.
The AEG oven has no numbered programs for this recipe; use the named dial function Conventional Cooking.
The manual text confirms voltage and functions, but not total wattage or a printed full oven temperature range.

appliances.name: AEG Competence BE3002420M
appliances.role: Main bake: one pie on the lower shelf using the manual's apple-pie guidance.
appliances.settings: Conventional Cooking, shelf position 1, 180 C, 70-90 min

appliances.name: AEG BE3002420M function chart
appliances.role: Shows the real oven-function symbols so the correct dial setting can be selected.
appliances.settings: Use the Conventional Cooking row: two horizontal bars

appliances.name: Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SI
appliances.role: Quickly rubs cold butter into flour and brings shortcrust dough together.
appliances.settings: Low speed for butter; speed 1-2 only until dough clumps
appliances.accessory: 5 L stainless bowl or 7 L EasyWarm bowl; stainless K-beater

appliances.name: Adam B0D1V55NWQ apple slicer
appliances.role: Cores apples into 12 wedges before knife-slicing them thinner for even filling.

visuals.title: Pie Layering
visuals.caption: Layer order for a clean slice: dish, bottom crust, apples, top crust, vents.

visuals.title: AEG Dial Reference
visuals.caption: Use Conventional Cooking for this single pie: the symbol with two horizontal bars.

steps.title: Prepare cold dough ingredients
steps.needs: Flour, cold butter, dough sugar, salt, egg, sour cream or cold water
steps.instruction: Cube the butter. Weigh flour, sugar, and salt. Keep butter cold until it goes into the mixer.
steps.done: Butter is cold and cubed; dry ingredients are weighed.

steps.title: Mix shortcrust dough
steps.needs: Dry ingredients, cold butter, egg, sour cream or cold water
steps.appliance: Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SI
steps.accessory: 5 L stainless bowl or 7 L EasyWarm bowl; stainless K-beater
steps.settings: Low speed until sandy; speed 1-2 only until clumps form
steps.instruction: Mix flour, sugar, and salt. Add butter and mix until pea-sized. Add egg, then sour cream or cold water a spoonful at a time. Stop as soon as the dough clumps.
steps.done: Dough holds together when squeezed but is not smooth or warm.

steps.title: Divide and chill
steps.instruction: Divide dough into one larger base piece and one smaller top piece. Flatten into disks, cover, and chill.
steps.done: Dough is firm enough to roll without smearing butter.

steps.title: Prepare apple filling
steps.needs: Apples, sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, starch
steps.accessory: Adam apple slicer, knife, large bowl
steps.settings: Manual slicer: 12 wedges, then knife-slice to 3-5 mm
steps.instruction: Peel apples if desired. Core with the apple slicer, then cut wedges into thin slices. Toss with brown sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, and starch.
steps.done: Apple slices are evenly coated and just starting to release juice.

steps.title: Preheat AEG oven
steps.instruction: Set the function dial to Conventional Cooking, the symbol with two horizontal bars. Set 180 C. Put the wire shelf on shelf position 1.
steps.done: Oven is fully preheated before the pie goes in.

steps.title: Assemble pie
steps.needs: Chilled dough, apple filling, breadcrumbs/semolina, egg wash
steps.accessory: Pie dish, rolling pin, pastry brush
steps.settings: Roll base slightly larger than dish; cut vents in top
steps.instruction: Roll the base and fit it into the dish. Sprinkle breadcrumbs or semolina if using. Add apples. Roll the top, cover, seal edges, cut vents, brush with beaten egg, and add coarse sugar if using.
steps.done: Top is sealed and vented; no large tears in the crust.

steps.title: Bake
steps.instruction: Bake on shelf position 1. Check at 70 min. If the rim browns too early, shield the edge loosely with foil while the centre finishes.
steps.done: Crust is deep golden and apple juices bubble through the vents.

steps.title: Cool and slice
steps.needs: Baked pie, cooling rack or heatproof counter
steps.instruction: Cool before cutting so the starch can set the apple juices.
steps.done: Slices lift without the filling flooding out.

sync_points.name: Oven-ready
sync_points.criteria: Dough is chilled and rolled, filling is mixed, pie is sealed and vented, and the AEG oven is at 180 C Conventional Cooking.

sync_points.name: Bake check
sync_points.criteria: If juices are not bubbling, continue baking in 10 min checks up to 90 min.

food_safety: Wash hands, tools, and work surface after handling raw egg.
Cool leftovers, then refrigerate if keeping longer than the day of baking.
Reheat slices until hot throughout if serving later.
